A useful discovery

The first real paragraph explains the discovery, why it matters to readers, and what the researchers actually observed. It is deliberately distinct from the search description in the page metadata.

The second paragraph adds the context: this is a modest result rather than a sweeping claim, and the data should be read alongside its limitations. A deep dive receives this whole passage, not an invented conversation.

The conclusion names what remains unknown and invites further investigation. A parser must preserve both the evidence and its caveats rather than mixing unrelated navigation into the narration.
